data.name: Amaniyyat
data.gender_notes: Amaniyyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'amana' which means 'to trust, to place one's trust, to believe, to rely, to be safe, to be secure, to be sure, to be confident'. The name Amaniyyat means 'Trustworthy, Reliable, One who can be depended upon'. The name Amaniyyat carries the meaning “Trust, Reliance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amaniyyat usually hope their child will grow to embody trust, reliance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, Amaniyyat represents the trust and faith one has in Allah, the belief in the divine protection and guidance, and the confidence in the journey of life. It is a name that resonates with the heart and soul, inspiring a sense of security, peace, and hope.
data.etymology: Amaniyyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust, Reliance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amaniyyat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أمانيات
in_arabic.meaning: أمانيات تعني الأمن والسلام في اللغة العربية وتوحي بالطمأنينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أمانيات مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أمن' والذي يعني الأمان والسلام. يوحي الاسم بالطمأنينة والسكينة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن النعيم والراحة في الجنة. يشير الاسم إلى الأمان من كل مكروه والسلام الداخلي الذي يأتي من الإيمان والتوكل على الله. في التقاليد الإسلامية، يعتبر الاسم محمودًا لما يحمله من معاني جميلة وطيبة.

in_hindi.name: अमानिय्यात
in_hindi.meaning: अमानिय्यात का अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा की कामना करना
